Merged the first PR in the eth1.0-specs repo: https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/pull/219 It's official now 😛 🎉 woot woot! nice job <@!689161464829050960>, <@!497280885645639691>, <@!564718359304863744> and thanks <@!364458974906548225> for reviews!! Hm. Any chance we could register ethereum.fyi and point it at the github pages for this repo? I really like fyi domains 😛 do you happen to own that domain? I don't think anyone can stop you from doing it lol? Nope, it's reserved ah rip How do we handle PRs into `ethereum/eth1.0-specs` now? Just make 'em and let you guys merge? <@!689161464829050960> I'm checking to see if you and/or <@!543900561460822016> can perhaps have merge access 😄 Maybe only 25% merge access though. Think it's worth setting up a redirect from `https://quilt.github.io/eth1.0-specs/` to wherever the canonical repository will live? i asked Jamie about adding you guys to merge access yesterday as well
